title: CCSMP
description: This is the datapack that used to be used by the CCSMP. It will still recieve updates.
body:
This is the datapack that used to be used in the CCSMP. It will still recieve updates by bloofin (and maybe anhnong2011), and is allowed for use in other servers. It would be nice to also credit the pack if you would like to use it. There is a [wiki](https://ccsmp.miraheze.org/wiki/Main_Page) that is still in production (mostly due to the fact that I don't know how wiki's work).
# FEATURES
## 1: Custom Trim Abilities
Currently, only these trims are missing their abilities:
- Flow
- Rib
- Dune
- Spire
- ward
## 2: Custom Items
There are many custom items, roughly around 20 at this time. Some of them include the _Drills_, weapons such as the _Hasty Katana_, _Chainsaw_, and _Shadowfang_, and even QOL items, like the _Reinforced Elytra_ and _Steak Sandwich_. Everything will hopefully be on the wiki at the time that this fully releases.
## 3: Custom Enchantments
There is currently 2 custom enchantments, being:
- End Slayer: More damage to End Mobs
- Excavation: Allows digging of 3x3x3 areas.
## 4: "End Rework"
It's in quotations cause it doesn't really add much. Changes to The End:
### Ender Dragon:
Has 400 HP now, and can summon crystals to heal herself. The dragon also has a modified loot table, allowing you to craft some of the custom items, aswell as other things.
### End Biomes:
- Added a new biome: "End Forest", that can generate trees or lakes.
- Added End fishing, which allows you to fish up _Enderium_ if you have an _Enderium Rod_.
- Added Enderium Tools (only sword and pickaxe at the moment).
## 5: Combat Log
- Even if _**gamerule:keepinventory**_ is enabled, dying to other players will still drop your loot, and logging off in combat will cause you to die upon rejoining.
